chapter: Willy Lewis band in Paris and Egypt
title: Tarbooshes in Alexandria and Chittison jailed
summary: The band wore tarbooshes to avoid street hustlers; at the club Chittison dropped a note into a woman's hand, waiters seized him and he was jailed overnight.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: You were talking about Chits. And -= Chitteson, right, and you were telling him said, he just told you last, he had to have one of those pretty women.

He said he loved them, so all right, we're on the bandstand. Chitteson didn't realize that in fact the man had given all of us turbans or taboosh(?) to put on our heads, you see, because they liked us.

The Englishman was telling us, don't wear them. You see, in the streets at that time, you go on the street and the guy had the sword in his hand and put it to your face and threatened you unless you gave him some money. Give him backshe, give him some money.

Yeah. (inaudible) get rid of him. That's a hustle. Have various things, but it was a hustle. But when you had that tabush on your heard, he didn't bother you. A citizen of Alexander, didn't bother you, and put that tabush on my head and went to another hotel and for half of -- talking about. a pound a day, so that's what I'm. So this man had a tabush, and we had our tabush, and we played with them on, and the that bomb in that woman's hand man saw Chitteson drop/ and the man clapped his hands, and all the waiters grabbed Chitteson and drug him out of there and the next thing Chitteson was in jail.
And then, this was round about 11:00. They write

it all in longhand and had Chitterson in there and the man, when Evans says well, what, he doesn't know, so he let him go. Let Chitterson go. Chitterson says, what's happening now, and these people are known to cut people's heads off.
